about: Real OS screens for the business reels (2026-10-22): the Atlas Consulting demo workspace, never the real one, phone width (375 px layout), 1500x3248, page colour #000000. Captured in the browser pane at 4x in four tiles, stitched. Shown in the split panel at z 0.72 (1500 wide = 1080), which sees 1333 px of the page around `focus` (y of the view's centre, 667-2581); each use takes the next focus. `keywords`: words or phrases in a sentence that call this screen (lowercase, matched on whole words; a trailing * matches any ending). `hook`: may open a reel when the hook names no screen. Reports is left out (it shows revenue); a screen with "use": false stays out (its note says why); `max` caps a screen's focus; comment-to-dm keeps its revenue card out of view (focus at most 1300). In tasks.png the demo task 'Log yesterday's DMs' is hidden (the brief: no manual logging); in research.png the 'needs Apify' line is hidden.
